title: Leela and Manav: profit with partner's rent
body: Leela and Manav are equal partners with capitals of Rs. 4,00,000 and Rs. 2,00,000. The firm's profit for the year ended March 31, 2026 was Rs. 2,40,000, before paying rent of Rs. 4,000 per month to Leela for her building, which the firm uses as a godown. The deed provides interest on capital at 5 per cent per annum and a salary of Rs. 36,000 per year to Manav. Interest on drawings is Rs. 1,200 for Leela and Rs. 800 for Manav.
